title: ListMyOwnedOrganizersCallablePayload
description: The signed-in user reads the organizers they own (ownerUserId, or the legacy hostUserId when no owner is recorded), a page at a time in organizer id order. afterOrganizerId continues from the previous page's nextAfterOrganizerId; limit is the page size. Used by the host billing website to choose an organizer. Status only; it carries no prices.
